\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]

  % (a) 1 -> 2
  \begin{scope}

  \begin{scope}[xshift=4.6cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.0,0.7); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.15,0); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.0,-0.7);

  \node[fdS] at (4.9,-2.6) {cubic vertex $-i\frac{g}{3!}\cdot3!=-ig$; counts $\frac{3!}{2^\ell\,\ell!}$; no first-order process between on-shell particles};
